name: Learn CAD with Civil Engineer
description:
Hello Students! My name is Er. Arun Banjare.
Is channel par main aapko Civil Engineering aur Architectural Design ke sabhi important CAD softwares zero se lekar expert level tak sikhaunga. Mera maqsad hai aapko industry-ready professional banana.

💎 CIVIL & ARCHITECTURE COURSES (Hindi Tutorials):

● AutoCAD 2D + 3D Complete Course (Basic to Pro)

● 25x25 & 30x40 Residential Planning

● Revit Architecture (BIM Modeling)

● Structural Detailing & Submission Drawings

● AutoCAD Shortcuts & Expert Tips

💎 SPECIAL PROJECTS & PLANNING:

● Small Plot Design (Specialist in 25x25 Plots)

● Interior Layouts & Furniture Planning

● Site Knowledge for Civil Engineers

😊 FREE RESOURCES & LEARNING 👇:-
🔸 AutoCAD Beginners Series (Free on YouTube)
🔸 House Plan Playlists (Step-by-Step)
🔸 Direct Support for Students
